_comment: THE ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the owner's other projects.
Three things read this file: the Projects section on site/index.html, the
demo catalogue in site/static/demo-api.js, and scripts/seed-projects.py,
which writes them into the real links catalogue when a cluster is up.
Writing the same four links in three places is exactly the duplication
this project keeps paying for, so scripts/check-doc-drift.py verifies the
HTML section against this file and fails if they disagree.
url: null means NOT YET SUPPLIED. Every consumer skips those entries
rather than rendering a dead link, and the drift checker reports them as
pending. A placeholder that renders is worse than one that does not: a
broken link on a portfolio page is read as carelessness, not as a TODO.
repo is a fallback, never a substitute. It is shown as a secondary link
where it exists, so a project with no deployment still has somewhere to go.
